services.name: Rental Application
services.desc: Licensee's Insurance - Liability Insurance is mandatory for events and/or activities at The Centre (Centre Church). A minimum coverage limit of $5,000,000 Commercial General Liability insurance against third party claims for bodily injury, death, property, and loss of use must be obtained prior to 30 days of your event. Licensee must provide evidence of insurance, in the form of a Standard Insurance Certificate completed by the insurance company and must be provided before permission will be given for use of our facility. Licensee is free to obtain the required insurance from any insurance company of their choice, provided the coverage obtained meets the minimum insurance requirements.
